title: GOD MODE UNLOCKED - Hardware Backdoors in x86 CPUs
summary: Christopher Domas's Black Hat talk demonstrates a hardware backdoor in a third-party x86 processor, a hidden core that grants root from userland. He uses it to discuss how feasible broader hardware backdoors might be.
why: Cited in hardware-trust and supply-chain threads as a concrete, startling demonstration of chip-level backdoors.

quote.text: I've seen too many mind-blowing presentations from security researchers to think I can bound their abilities safely.
